newsitem.title: FINLAND: Konecranes sets new high, seen fragile.
newsitem.headline: Konecranes sets new high, seen fragile.

text.p: Finnish cranes maker KCI Konecranes International Oy set a new high in moderate trade on Tuesday following a German acquisition unveiled on Monday but it was seen fragile after recent sharp gains, brokers said.
At 1555/1355 GMT, Konecranes traded at a new life high 144.00 markka, up 9.00 markka or more than six percent from Monday's close. Trade was a moderate 2.4 million markka.
Konecranes on Monday said it would buy German MAN GHH Logistics' standard crane operations for an undisclosed sum.
Konecranes has risen almost 112 percent since its initial public offering at 68.00 markka per share in March 1996.
After such strong gains, brokers saw a downside to the stock in possible profit-taking.
